### Brewery  (fields: 9)

  - state                  scalar_ent   [gsi]   fk_to=State  ex: Maine
  inverse_fks:
    ← Beer.brewery_id  (entity_fk)  -- back-walk: find_nodes(entity_type:"Beer", where:{brewery_id:"<this.doc_key>"})
